sentences.en: Chris is very attractive and wealthy, but not very modest.
sentences.zh: 克里斯不仅相貌出众而且非常富有，但并不谦虚。

sentences.en: Because he was wealthy, he was able to go there.
sentences.zh: 因为他很有钱，所以他能去那里。

sentences.en: Judging from those facts, Mr Mori must be a wealthy person.
sentences.zh: 从这些事实来看， Mori 先生一定是个富有的人。
